mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities that increase nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk of aminoglycoside tobramycin, while tobramycin may cause acute kidney injury that reduces chlorthalidone clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes, and audiometry closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic or antibiotic if possible; adjust tobramycin dosing based on renal function.
